thread:
alex: quick preflight for tonight's fanout rollout. sequence US -> EU -> APAC. window 19:45-22:15 PT. canary steps: 1% -> 3% -> 20% -> full. keep APAC on manual hold because of a scheduled cooling window.
nina: alerts primed. rollback criteria: error_rate >= 1% for 5m OR p95 increase > 120ms sustained for 3m. I'll call rollback if either trips.
vikram: warm pool check: US free=180/300, EU free=55/120, APAC free=26/80. APAC has HVAC maintenance at 01:30 local 1: keep manual.
ops-bot: capacity snapshot: us-west-2 free=180 total=300; eu-west-1 free=55 total=120; ap-northeast-1 free=26 total=80. command: `opsctl pool status --regions us,eu,apac`
alex: @deploy-bot start US canary 1% version=v1.2.3 pin=true fallback=v1.2.2
deploy-bot: canary started: id cb-2840001111 region=us percent=1 version=v1.2.3 fallback=v1.2.2
jade: enabling KV warmup and small prompt-cache for the canary. payload: `curl -s -X POST https://infra/cache/warm -d '{"id":"cb-2840001111","regions":["us"]}'`
nina: 8m check: p95=195ms, error_rate=0.03%, cpu=68%  looks stable. hold 12m before stepping.
vikram: no thermal flags in US. EU nominal. APAC unchanged.
deploy-bot: gate set: waiting 12m of stability before stepping to 3% in US.
alex: rollback playbook reminder: cancel canary, promote fallback, region-first rollback. snippet: `redwoodctl rollout cancel cb-2840001111 && redwoodctl promote --version v1.2.2 --region us`
nina: 13m: stepping US to 3% now. watching latency and errors.
deploy-bot: canary cb-2840001111 stepped to 3% (region=us)
ops-bot: capacity update: US.free=174, EU.free=54, APAC.free=26. no capacity alarms.
jade: cache prefill completed. remember to revert cache aggressiveness after finalization.
nina: 25m at 3%: error_rate=0.11%, p95=218ms. green to queue EU at 1% but leave EU operator hold for 20m observation.
avex: (typo) alex: noted. APAC remains manual. release-manager will draft announcement after EU 1% start.
release-manager: draft msg ready: "Rolling v1.2.3: US at 3% stable; EU queued; APAC manual hold. See live updates in #eng-releases."
vikram: if EU hits any CPU thermal drift, we keep APAC pinned and use routing fallback to v1.2.2 slot for affected slices.
ops-bot: final snapshot for thread: US.free=172, EU.free=54, APAC.free=26.
release-manager: thanks team 1: next sync +30m or immediately on any alarm. :thumbsup:
